claim: Scroll speed pulls the card like taffy along its travel — stretching long mid-fling, relaxing square as the page settles.

q1_defects.answer: No broken/blank states. Idle is a clean ship-quality card (brass header, blue dot, 3 grey rows, rounded panel) sitting low at rest. play-3 well-framed, chrome crisp. At extreme stretch (settleDamping-low, travel-high) the card fills much of the frame and the bottom grey row can graze the frame edge, but all chrome stays legible — acceptable stretch behavior, not a defect.

q2_reads_as.answer: Reads precisely as velocity stretch / taffy: stretchGain-high elongates the card dramatically tall along its travel axis with the accent dot stretching into a vertical oval and the panel/rows elongating, while stretchGain-low is near-square (relaxed). Exactly the 'stretch long mid-fling, relax square at rest' claim. Same card subject as ground truth, chrome intact at full stretch.
evidence: control: stretchGain changed=true (low.luma=16.4 band=0.534 -> high.luma=18.5 band=0.447)

q3_discoverable.answer: All three labeled controls produce clear, sensible visible change: 'Stretch Gain' scales the elongation, 'travel' moves the up-frame position with stretch, and 'settleDamping' controls residual stretch (low damping = very tall, high damping = squarer). A user dragging any slider immediately sees the taffy respond.

q4_responsive.answer: Responsive: play frame deltas 9.57/12.13/12.80 show continuous motion, and every control changes the frame with monotonic luma/banding progressions. No dead controls.
evidence: metrics: play-1 delta=9.57 play-2 delta=12.13 play-3 delta=12.80
control: all 3 changed=true (stretchGain luma 16.4->18.5, settleDamping luma 19.0->17.6)

q5_net.answer: A user would be PLEASED: 'oh nice, the card stretches like taffy when I fling it and snaps back square when I let go' — the headline effect is dramatic, premium, on-claim, and every slider does something sensible.

flags.note: At the most extreme stretch (settleDamping-low) the card is large enough that the bottom grey row grazes the lower frame edge; cosmetic, chrome still legible.
